item.title: Kansas man honored for heroic rescue in boating accident
item.description: A Tescott man was named the Kansas Sheriff's Association's 2025 Citizen of the Year on Friday for his role in saving a girl's life last summer.

item.title: Going digital: Change by KU could get Kansas firefighters certified faster
item.description: Up to now, the tests have been done on pen-and-paper tests that were shipped to each location, shipped back to be scanned and graded, with the results then shipped to students.

item.title: Water line break prompts boil water advisory in Kansas town
item.description: The Kansas Department of Health and Environment said a water line break resulted in a loss of pressure in the distribution system, which can lead to bacterial contamination.

item.title: Texas, Kansas students win nearly $200,000 in Wichita State scholarships
item.description: Mackenzie Buci, Kayden Lankford and Samantha McClintock were each awarded $64,000 to attend Wichita State University.

item.title: Kansas bookkeeper indicted in $1.5 million tax fraud
item.description: A Kansas bookkeeper is accused of failing to pay over $1.5 million in payroll taxes for clients.

item.title: Man who tried to kill wife outside Wichita school gets nearly three decades
item.description: Vincent Solomon was sentenced to 27½ years in prison for attempted first-degree murder and other charges.

item.title: Proposed Kansas bill could end yearly car registration renewals
